_comment: FYRDrop egg for FeatherPanel. Best-effort community format — if your FeatherPanel version rejects it, import the Pterodactyl egg (FeatherPanel supports Pterodactyl egg imports).
name: FYRDrop
description: Self-hosted sharing hub: files, text, image gallery, self-signed certificates, P2P transfer and federation.
author: potenfyr-studios@users.noreply.github.com

docker_images.name: FYRDrop official (latest)
docker_images.description: Bun runtime with the FYRDrop app and built-in client bundle.

install_scripts.name: prepare data
install_scripts.script:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /home/container/data/files /home/container/data/thumbs /home/container/data/certs /home/container/data/uploads_tmp
echo "FYRDrop data directories ready."
exit 0

variables.name: Max Upload (MB)
variables.description: Maximum size of a single uploaded file in megabytes.

variables.name: TLS Enabled
variables.description: 0 = plain HTTP (default; right on a trusted network or behind a proxy). auto = HTTPS with an auto-generated self-signed certificate.

variables.name: TLS Common Name
variables.description: Common name for the auto-generated TLS certificate.

variables.name: Session TTL (days)
variables.description: How long a paired device stays signed in.
